segments.text: Manny has recently started fencing, and he turns out to be excellent at it. The whole family comes to watch one of his competitions, and Jay is especially proud. Manny wins several matches and reaches the final.

segments.text: Then Jay and Gloria learn that the girl has lost both her parents and is being treated at a children’s hospital. When other children from the hospital arrive to cheer for her, they start feeling terrible.
